description:
Read earnings disclosures for a ten-digit CIK; dates filter filing_date (YYYY-MM-DD).

        Same-period sources are not distinct new earnings. CIK identifies the registrant;
        periods groups its reviewed own-quarter sources by end date. sources reference records[].items[].id.
        ungrouped retains all other visible items, including pending ones. Each source keeps its metrics and basis.
name: get_earnings
